newsitem.title: USA: Rubin praises Greenspan as "outstanding" Fed chief.
newsitem.headline: Rubin praises Greenspan as "outstanding" Fed chief.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Thursday praised Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan but steered clear of commenting specifically on the central bank's monetary policy.
"Alan Greenspan has been an outstanding Fed Chairman," Rubin told reporters following a speech to a meeting of the the Investment Company Institute.

Greenspan has come in for criticism recently from both Democratic and Republican lawmakers for raising interest rates in March for the first time in more than two years. Rubin declined comment on that criticism.

He said the Clinton administration supports the independence of the Fed and argued that stance has served the country well, enhancing the credibility of U.S. financial markets and thus helping the economy.
